summary: Implementation plan for Cadence v1.3.1 (Issue #10): replaces false 1-hour MSE live stream countdowns with tiered HTML5/DOM live detection, adds a live-edge indicator, real-time "Live in Xm @ R×" catch-up math with clickable Jump to Live resync, guards Stop-at-End and live-head 1.0× clamping, and adds an interactive Live DVR test scenario to the Workbench simulator.
